result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my top recommendation is **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify—in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best option depends on your ecommerce platform, where your customers are located, and how much you're selling.

Since you're in Australia, here's how I'd compare the main options for an Australian small business.

## Best payment processors compared

Australian market · 2026

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Domestic cards: 1.65% + A\$0.30
- No monthly processing fee
- Excellent integrations and reporting
- Supports subscriptions and international payments

Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and independent online stores.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Basic online domestic cards: approximately 1.75% + A\$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Easy refunds and reconciliation
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees

Best if your website runs on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Domestic commercial transactions: approximately 2.9% + A\$0.30
- Familiar to many customers
- Easy checkout integration
- Useful as an additional payment option

Best as a secondary checkout option alongside Stripe.

[PayPal Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online domestic processing: around 2.2%
- Simple setup
- Integrates online and in-person sales
- Useful inventory and POS features

Best if you also sell at markets, events or a physical shop.

[Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

Indicative published rates; actual charges depend on card type, plan and transaction circumstances. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd actually recommend

For a new small online store, I'd keep things simple\:

- **Primary processor\:** Stripe or Shopify Payments.
- **Secondary payment option\:** PayPal.
- **Avoid initially\:** Expensive merchant accounts with monthly fees and complicated contracts.

You want customers to be able to pay using\:

- Visa and Mastercard
- Apple Pay
- Google Pay
- PayPal
- Buy now, pay later (if it suits your products and margins)
